chunks: Aḥmad ibn Muḥammad ibn Abī Naṣr al-Bazanṭī asked Abū al-Ḥasan al-Riḍā عليه السلام about a man who uses an enema due to an illness during the month of Ramadan.
He عليه السلام said: "It is not permissible for a fasting person to use an enema."

key_terms.شَهْرِ رَمَضَانَ: the month of Ramadan, during which fasting is observed
key_terms.يَحْتَقِنُ: to administer or use an enema

ai.seo_question: Is it permissible for a fasting person to use an enema during Ramadan?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning sawm in the month of Ramadan. Imam al-Riḍā عليه السلام states that a fasting person is not permitted to use an enema, indicating that this act is prohibited for one observing the fast.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1869 - Ahmad ibn Muhammad ibn Abi Nasr al-Bazanti asked Abu al-Hasan al-Ridha (as) about a man who uses an enema due to illness during the Month of Ramadan.
Imam (as) said: "A fasting person is not permitted to use an enema."
